angleRead.name: Jordan Velez
angleRead.text: I’m chasing the story of Temescal’s businesses—Gridiron Analytics, OakTown Social, and Temescal Community Health Center—through the people who work there. The numbers show growth, but I want to know what’s happening behind the counter, in the back office, and on the hiring board. What’s driving this momentum? What’s keeping owners up at night? I’ll start with Ariana Reyes at Gridiron Analytics, then hit OakTown Social to talk to Vanessa Treary and Vanessa Ramas. Bobby Chen-Ramirez at the health center will round it out. The block feels alive, but I need to see if the ledger matches the lived experience.
